| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Levels** `levels` | 3 | 1 to 5 | How many times the Laplacian pyramid halves the image. Each level gives one band, split into directions. |
| **Directions** `directions` | 8 | 4, 8, 16 | How many directional subbands each band has, over 180 degrees. The directional tree has 2, 3 or 4 levels. |
| **Threshold factor** `factor` | 3 | 0 to 8 | The threshold is this factor times the noise level in each subband. 0 keeps every coefficient, and the image comes back unchanged. |
| **Shrink rule** `mode` | Hard | Hard, Soft | Hard thresholding sets small coefficients to 0 and keeps the others. Soft thresholding also moves the others toward 0 by T. |
| **Noise sigma** `sigma` | 0 | 0 to 100 | The standard deviation of the noise, in pixel values. 0 estimates it from the finest diagonal wavelet details. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
